_comment: z/OS Connect real-world example — hand-authored reconstruction of the shape of IBM's CICS catalog manager sample (the DFH0XCMN 'EGUI' application used throughout z/OS Connect provider tutorials): inquire the catalog, inquire a single item, and place an order, all backed by one COBOL program. No third-party text copied.

apiProvider.name: CatalogManagerProvider
apiProvider.description: Inbound provider exposing the CICS catalog manager sample program as REST.
